title: French GHG Emissions Fall as Surging Fuel Prices Suppress Consumption
detail: French greenhouse gas emissions are declining as soaring fuel prices reduce consumption across the country, according to Le Monde. The drop represents an unintended climate benefit of the energy price surge, though it raises concerns about the economic burden on households and businesses.

title: 'Act V' of Student Movement: Education Strikes, Blocked High Schools, Nationwide Demonstrations
detail: France's student mobilization enters its fifth major episode with a strike in the education sector, high schools blocked by protesters, and nationwide demonstrations. The movement marks a significant escalation of youth-led activism in the education and higher education sectors across France.

title: Oxfam France Sues State Over 'Rupture of Equality Before Taxation'
detail: Oxfam France files a lawsuit against the French state alleging a 'rupture of equality before taxation' that allows the wealthiest citizens to escape standard tax obligations. The case represents a domestic political and legal challenge to Macron-era fiscal policy, arguing that existing tax arrangements unconstitutionally privilege the ultra-rich.

title: Anti-Terrorism Prosecutor Called in After Aubagne Shooting; Suspect Linked to Mass-Killing Glorification Movement
detail: France's National Anti-Terrorism Prosecutor (PNAT) has been called in to investigate a shooting in Aubagne. The suspect is believed to adhere to the TCC (Tueries de Masse / mass killings glorification) movement, raising concerns about a new form of extremist radicalization in France beyond traditional jihadist or far-right profiles.

title: Judicial Oversight Body (CSM) Publicly Opposes Government's Appointment of Rachida Dati
detail: France's Conseil Supérieur de la Magistrature (CSM), the independent body overseeing the judiciary, has publicly opposed the chancellery's proposed appointment of Rachida Dati to a judicial post. The standoff marks a rare public confrontation between the executive branch and judicial oversight institutions, highlighting ongoing tensions over judicial independence in France.

title: Tours Police Officer Placed Under Investigation for Blinding Student During Protests
detail: A police officer in Tours has been placed under formal judicial investigation (mis en examen) for aggravated violence after blinding a high school student during protests. The investigation follows a formal complaint and legal proceedings. The case adds to ongoing national debate in France about police use of force against student and youth demonstrators.

title: OpenAI Announces Arrest of Employee Suspected of Planting Listening Device Inside Company
detail: OpenAI announced the arrest of an employee suspected of planting a listening device (microphone) inside the company's offices, according to Le Monde. The case raises concerns about corporate espionage and internal security at one of the world's leading artificial intelligence firms.
